dialogues.speaker: Lost Treasure Hoarder Journal
dialogues.text: "...Discovered an ancient ruin that remains unmarked on any map. The entrance has completely collapsed. If I manage to find a way in, I may discover some rare treasure..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost Treasure Hoarder Journal
dialogues.text: "Convincing everyone that whatever's in there is gonna be worth our while was tough going... The next part's gonna be a walk in the park by contrast. There's no need to keep a low profile here..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost Treasure Hoarder Journal
dialogues.text: "Didn't find aught else but this arcane formation and the peculiar barriers around it, and after all that effort, too..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost Treasure Hoarder Journal
dialogues.text: "There seems to be someone trapped inside the barriers... Can't tell if they are alive or not. Well, I'm not going back empty-handed, not after how far I've gone. That's just not my style..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost Treasure Hoarder Journal
dialogues.text: (The remaining pages are filled with black stains, making the text unreadable.)
